Pending cleanup after the next TermAl restart (Fable2, 2026-11-19 ~20:30Z). Each entry is an EMPTY directory that a process still holds open, so a non-forced removal fails with "being used by another process". Leave it until a restart releases the handle, then remove it non-forced. Codex executes, per AGENTS.md "Cleanup deletions". No forced deletion without Greg's per-case word, and no process stops.
- .tmp/wt-b912-9474: no Git registration and no reparse point. Likely held by finished evaluator children 18989, 18990 and 19053 (Opus3 #5636). Sol-a7bb's evidence is note 309130ff on w-f1559f4bd64c.
- Also listed earlier by Opus2 (#6916): the empty freeze residuals docsb2 and b12, with an unknown holder.
The restart sweep removes these and records the result.
